evidence: slot list derived from data; art itself is INFERRED until drawn

rules.naming: PNG, exact slot file name, lowercase folder names under res://art/
rules.canvas: draw at the documented canvas size; the game scales by height, so keep the subject inside a centre-safe area
rules.pivot: every slot is anchored at its centre (0.5, 0.5)
rules.facing: ships face UP, enemies and bosses face DOWN, bullets face their travel direction
rules.fallback: a missing file never crashes: the slice draws the vector shape and logs the slot
rules.no_original_assets: draw new art; do not extract or copy the original game's sprites

display_notes.unit: 1 world unit = 1/20 of the 20-unit playfield width; the 9:16 canvas shows about 10.8 x 19.2 units
display_notes.shipping: put files under game/art/ so the export packs them; user://art/ is also read for drop-in tests
